summary: Import ResQ Reserving Class now brings across the calculated and Engine-generated datasets of the reserving class, which the review table never listed and the import silently left out.
details: The review table deliberately hides datasets both systems rebuild from their inputs, but the import only brought across what was ticked, so those datasets never reached ArcRho.
They are now imported whatever was ticked, and when the class already exists in ArcRho the usual merge or overwrite rule decides between the fresh copy and the existing one.
Dataset types ArcRho does not configure are still skipped, as before.
